answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on the attestation graph, with transition mass attenuated at each step. A Sybil cluster with few links to honest nodes has low conductance, so a min-cut and conductance bound limit the stationary probability—and thus aggregate voting weight—that can cross into it. Repeated attestations cannot echo beyond this sparse boundary; hollow endorsements lose influence as the tide of honest mass remains separated.
